headline: Public hearing on loan order for land acquisition at 276 Broadway for Senior Center.
summary: The agenda includes a public hearing on a loan order to acquire land at 276 Broadway for a Senior Center. It also includes motions on a residency requirement for development projects and on penalties for improper use of license plate readers.
items: Notice on how to watch online and how to sign up in advance to speak remotely, with sign-up due by 4:00 PM on the meeting day
Public hearing on loan order for land acquisition at 276 Broadway for Senior Center, scheduled for 7 PM
Motion to get an update on a draft ordinance requiring a 25% apprenticeship or residency requirement on development projects
Motion to get input on a path to ask the State to set criminal penalties for unlawful or improper use of ALPRs by authorized users
Informational reports on the Zoning Rewrite and GFOA
Communication on the resignation of Chan Huot from the Lowell Cultural Council
Vote to accept and expend $115k in FY27 earmarked funds for rapid rectangular flash beacons
Vote to accept and expend $65,000 FY27 Municipal Road Safety Grant from LPD
Non-Profit Organization SC report dated October 20, 2026

Wire inspector reports: Boston Gas requests to relocate a gas main on Stockbridge Avenue, replace gas mains along Lawrence and Woburn Streets, replace gas mains on Leroy, Canal and Grove Streets, and replace gas mains on Llewellyen, Beacon, Third and Bennett Streets
Petition for a claim for property damage
Petition from Hilda Pimentel Negron to install a handicap parking sign at 92 Fort Hill Avenue (Apt. 2)
Petition from Boston Gas to replace existing gas mains at 217-250 Westford Street and portion of Lane and Fernald Streets
Petition from National Grid to install underground electric conduit along Robeson Street for service at 225 Middlesex Street
Petition from Zayo Enterprise Networks to install underground fiber optic conduit at 174 South Street
location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA / Zoom (Hybrid)
